nodes.label: US-01 Bootstrap the Nx monorepo
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Single Nx workspace for Next.js and Maven Spring Boot so both stacks share one graph, task runner, and CI cache.

nodes.label: US-02 Publish architecture docs and Firestore rules
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Write the Firestore model, REST contract, SEC colors, rules, parity checklist, and open decisions as one source of truth.

nodes.label: US-03 Stand up the Spring Boot API with Firestore persistence
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Spring Boot REST API with BaseRepository, DTOs for nine collections, and no browser CORS.

nodes.label: US-04 Authenticate with Google via an HttpOnly session cookie
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Replace JAAS with a Firebase ID token exchanged once for an HttpOnly __session cookie.

nodes.label: US-05 Manage seasons and season weeks via REST
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Manager CRUD for seasons and weeks. Manual weeks are Thursday through Wednesday; imported CFBD weeks are not.

nodes.label: US-06 Manage venues, teams, and rivalries via REST
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Manager CRUD with embedded venue and team snapshots and optional CFBD ids.

nodes.label: US-07 Manage matchups via REST
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Manager CRUD for weekly matchups. winningTeamId is derived. Optional unique cfbdGameId.

nodes.label: US-08 Manage users and themes via REST
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. User and theme admin. Roles mirror Firebase claims. At least one role. No passwords.

nodes.label: US-09 Load and save a player's weekly confidence picks
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. GET main joins matchups and picks in code. POST picks bulk-upserts and drops empty rows.

nodes.label: US-10 Rank players on the season leaderboard
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Sum rank for correct picks, sort score descending, tie-break by userId. Users with no picks score 0.

nodes.label: US-11 Show a team schedule and let a player edit their profile
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Conference W/L schedule and account nickName plus themeId. Email and name stay read-only.

nodes.label: US-12 Seed Firestore with reference data and themes
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Seed SEC reference data, 18 themes, and one bootstrap manager. No picks and no password hashes.

nodes.label: US-13 Scaffold the Next.js app and API client
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. App Router, Tailwind, TanStack Query, same-origin /api client. Replaces Tiles, jQuery, and Bootstrap.

nodes.label: US-14 Apply switchable Light, Dark, and SEC school themes
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Eighteen data-theme blocks and semantic tokens. Default Light. SSR sets data-theme to avoid a flash.

nodes.label: US-15 Sign in with Google and protect game and manager routes
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Login page, navbar, and middleware gates for game and manager routes. No register route.

nodes.label: US-16 Make and reorder weekly confidence picks
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Weekly picks grid with radio winners and up/down rank reorder, ported from main.jsp and main.js.

nodes.label: US-17 View the season leaderboard
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Rank, nickname, and score table from the leaderboard API.

nodes.label: US-18 Browse a conference team's schedule
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Conference-team dropdown loads the schedule with TanStack Query and no full page reload.

nodes.label: US-19 Update nickname and pick a theme
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Account page sets nickName and theme. Applying a theme sets data-theme immediately. No password fields.

nodes.label: US-20 Administer seasons, weeks, venues, teams, and rivalries
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Manager list and detail screens for reference data, replacing searchTemplate.jsp.

nodes.label: US-21 Administer matchups, users, and themes
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Matchup, user, and theme admin with cascading selects and venue auto-fill.

nodes.label: US-22 Enforce validation parity on client and server
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Port JSR-303 rules to Valibot and Spring. Password validators stay absent. Section predecessors also include US-34 beyond the index.

nodes.label: US-23 Meet WCAG AA contrast in every theme
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Every theme meets WCAG AA for text on surfaces and primary foreground on primary.

nodes.label: US-24 Prove parity with emulator tests and Playwright
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Firestore emulator tests, role tests, and a Playwright path. CFBD fixtures must not hit the live API in CI.

nodes.label: US-25 Deploy public Next.js and internal Spring Cloud Run
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Public Next.js and internal Spring. Session cookie stays first-party. Scheduler stays inside GCP.

nodes.label: US-26 Remove the legacy Struts application
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Delete src/ only after the parity checklist is fully checked.

nodes.label: US-27 Integrate the College Football Data API client
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Server-side CFBD client. The API key never reaches the browser. Wraps games, calendar, and scoreboard.

nodes.label: US-28 Import a season's SEC-team matchups from CFBD
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Import every game involving the 16 SEC teams, upsert by cfbdGameId, and do not write picks or uncompleted scores.

nodes.label: US-29 Automatically import scores on game days
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Game-day job writes final scores from completed CFBD games in America/New_York.

nodes.label: US-30 Trigger and review CFBD imports from the admin UI
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Matchups admin starts the import job and polls a created, updated, and skipped summary.

nodes.label: US-31 Proxy browser API calls through Next.js with Axios
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Server-only Axios BFF so the browser never calls Spring.

nodes.label: US-32 Verify the session cookie in Next.js middleware
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Middleware verifies the session cookie with Firebase Admin. Cookie presence alone is not authentication.

nodes.label: US-33 Lock down the BFF allowlist and internal jobs
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Proxy only auth, game, and manager. Internal jobs need OIDC or a shared secret, not the user cookie.

nodes.label: US-34 Lock picks at week start and reject tied scores
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Freeze the card when the week begins. Equal scores are 400. Ranks in a week must be unique.

nodes.label: US-35 Refresh snapshots and block unsafe deletes
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Team and venue edits rewrite denormalized snapshots. Deletes of referenced records return 409.

nodes.label: US-36 Keep the theme catalog a closed set of 18
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Managers cannot create a theme key that has no compiled CSS block.

nodes.label: US-37 Empty season, sign-in failure, and expired session
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Empty current season, Google failure, and expired session each have an explicit screen. Header brands Kenney's Pickem.

nodes.label: US-38 Harden CFBD import (calendar weeks, opponents, job)
nodes.rationale: Status: Done. Import returns 202 and a job id, upserts calendar weeks, and auto-creates missing opponents and venues.

nodes.label: US-39 Provision Firestore composite indexes
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Emulator and GCP share firestore.indexes.json so compound queries do not fail in production.

nodes.label: US-40 Expose Cloud Run health checks
nodes.rationale: Status: open. Unauthenticated /health on both services. The Next.js check does not call Spring.
